chromosomes.description: Chromosome allow-list; default from project chromosomes.
chromosomes.title: Chromosomes

contexts.description: Methylation contexts to scan; default CG only.
contexts.title: Contexts

dmp_panel_csv.description: Optional path to DMP discovery/selected CSV for locus overlap concordance.
dmp_panel_csv.title: Dmp Panel Csv

dynamics_enabled.description: Enable dynamic measures (channel capacity, RDE, turnover); deferred in v2 phase 1.
dynamics_enabled.title: Dynamics Enabled

ising_batch_tiles.description: Max tiles per GPU batch during Ising fit.
ising_batch_tiles.title: Ising Batch Tiles

ising_coupling.description: Pairwise coupling structure: nearest-neighbor or all-pairs within tile.
ising_coupling.title: Ising Coupling

ising_enabled.description: Enable v2 equilibrium Ising/max-entropy model per tile. Operator-set per profile/site.
ising_enabled.title: Ising Enabled

ising_l2.description: L2 ridge on Ising parameters for sparse tiles.
ising_l2.title: Ising L2

ising_max_iter.description: Maximum Newton iterations for batched Ising fit.
ising_max_iter.title: Ising Max Iter

ising_min_tile_reads.description: Minimum reads per tile for Ising model fitting (may exceed min_tile_reads).
ising_min_tile_reads.title: Ising Min Tile Reads

jsd_min_cohort_reads.description: Minimum summed reads per tile per cohort for JSD computation.
jsd_min_cohort_reads.title: Jsd Min Cohort Reads

jsd_top_windows.description: Number of top JSD windows to retain in confirmation report.
jsd_top_windows.title: Jsd Top Windows

mapper_gene_csv.description: Optional path to mapper all-gene_name-combined.csv for gene concordance.
mapper_gene_csv.title: Mapper Gene Csv

min_tile_reads.description: Minimum reads per tile for inclusion in aggregates.
min_tile_reads.title: Min Tile Reads

prefer_gpu.description: Prefer GPU via methyl_utils array backend; None = auto.
prefer_gpu.title: Prefer Gpu

sample_id_column.description: Column name for sample identifier in readlevel_measures.csv.
sample_id_column.title: Sample Id Column

tile_size.description: Expected tile width k in sidecar files. Operator-set per profile/site.
tile_size.title: Tile Size
